name: czrecoil_frame_on_menu_westwood_online_upgrade
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnMenuWestwoodOnlineUpgrade performs the one-time Winsock prompt, opens the Westwood Online upgrade dialog, and starts the selected upgrade mission with intro and mission FMV skipped.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4319a0 validates the g_CZRecoilFrame_WestwoodOnlineWinsockChecked gate, zLoc message ids 18 and 38 copied into 0x100 and 0x200 byte stack buffers, NetUi::VerifyWinsock2OrPromptContinue early-abort behavior, skip-intro and skip-mission-FMV writes before the modal dialog, WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ShowModalAndGetSelectedMissionIndex with the out pointer in ECX, and RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker(selectedMissionIndex + 6, 0, 1, g_HudSensorTracker.missionFlags) when the modal returns success.

Native smoke czrecoil_frame_on_menu_westwood_online_upgrade_smoke patches zLoc::GetMessageString, NetUi::VerifyWinsock2OrPromptContinue, WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ShowModalAndGetSelectedMissionIndex, and RecoilApp::LoadZbdAndSetupSensorTracker to verify the Winsock rejection path, already-checked modal cancel path, and first-check modal success path with selected mission id offset and HUD mission flags.
